title: Analyst Telecom, Media, Technology & Healthcare Sector (w/m/d)
full_description:
Frankfurt am Main, Germany
ING Wholesale Banking Germany is the corporate banking segment of ING Germany. Beyond traditional funding, we advise our corporate customers on sustainable and innovative financing projects – with a start-up spirit and the ambition to always be one step ahead. In the TMT&H Sector Coverage team, we are working to originate and develop client relationships with large companies in the Telecom, Media, Technology & Healthcare while also originating Projects in the digital infrastructure space. Apply now with your CV to join ING Wholesale Banking, one of the fastest growing corporate banks in Germany!
You enthusiastically join our origination activities and develop sophisticated pitch presentations as well as tailor-made multi-product solutions for our corporate clients.
Analysing complex financial information becomes your second nature: you prepare well-founded market and competition analyses, review information memoranda and term sheets, and make a measurable contribution to winning new mandates with your proposals.
You gain a deep understanding of the TMT and Healthcare sectors, monitor valuation levels, market and competitive dynamics, and keep track of macroeconomic developments. Through high-quality sector analyses, peer-group and trading benchmarks, valuation summaries, as well as management and board presentations, you support us in strategic client dialogues.
Working closely with our Senior Relationship Management, you participate in live transactions, contribute to the expansion of long-term client relationships, and identify new business opportunities – from pitchbooks and RfPs to due diligence documentation.
This also involves coordinating with internal product and coverage teams (including Corporate Finance, Lending, DCM/LCM, Financial Markets, Transaction Services, and Risk) as well as contributing to internal credit and investment committee processes.
Furthermore you support transactions throughout their entire lifecycle, assist in their structuring and evaluation.
In collaboration with the transaction management team, you assist in structuring and evaluating complex financing transactions and contribute to internal credit and investment committee processes.
In short: you take responsibility quickly, maintain a strong focus on data quality, governance, compliance, and regulatory requirements, engage in beyond-banking initiatives and ensure that projects are delivered on time and to the highest standards.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Law, or a comparable field
Initial practical experience in Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, and/or Structured Finance
Ideally, international experience and familiarity with relevant tools (e.g., Bloomberg, S&P Capital IQ, think-cell)
Strong analytical skills and a good understanding of economic and legal interrelations
Solid expertise in analysing financial statements, cash flow models, due diligence reports, and market analyses
Proficient in MS Office applications (especially Excel and PowerPoint)
Excellent communication skills, proactive mindset, and team spirit
The ability to look outside the box and develop sustainable solutions
Excellent written and spoken German and English
We offer many benefits
Company pension plan, capital-building offers, free Deutschlandticket & bicycle leasING, company restaurant
Hybrid working: In addition to working in the office, you can also work remotely – within operational, regulatory and legal requirements.
Individualized work schedule models, sabbatical, subsidization of nursing & childcare costs
Personal budget for continuing education and development as well as health; plus, a personal budget to set up your mobile working space
At ING we are colourful and diverse: different personalities with different perspectives - an international culture where we value and appreciate each other. We believe in substance over style, people instead of labels.
This describes you to a T?
Simply apply online -your resume is all we need to get to know you, a cover letter is optional!
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
